Exams allow one page of notes. Concept checks are graded for completion.

Assignment grading

Checkpoint 20%, final 80%. The final is graded on correctness (~50%), performance (~20%), and analysis (~30%); performance credit requires correct code. D3 and T3 end with a ten-minute code walkthrough with staff.

Late work

Five slip days per semester, at most two per submission, none on the capstone. Reference outputs are released 48 hours after each deadline; nothing is accepted after that. Cluster outages near a deadline move the deadline.

Collaboration and AI tools

Discuss freely; write your own code and analysis. Share code only with your capstone partner, on the capstone. You may use AI to explain concepts, read documentation, and debug, but not to write the parts a handout assigns to you. Cite AI use, including prompts.

Help and accommodations

Behind? Start the next stage from a reference output. Recitation and office hours cover tools and concepts. For accommodations, register with the Disability Resource Center and talk with an instructor early. The Rice Honor Code applies.
